picks.title: Spatial streaming brings adaptive video's playbook to 3D asset delivery
picks.headline: Spatial streaming brings adaptive video's playbook to 3D asset delivery
picks.excerpt: Modern video is powered by adaptive streaming: one source file reaches any screen, on any connection, with playback that starts near instantaneously. Miris brings that model to 3D. We spoke with Miris CTO Sean Looper about spatial streaming and what it means for developers.
picks.rationale: One source asset streamed adaptively to any device changes how teams budget LODs, downloads and build size — a direct pipeline decision.

picks.title: Roblox ships creator analytics, A/B testing and live-ops tooling
picks.headline: Roblox ships creator analytics, A/B testing and live-ops tooling
picks.excerpt: Roblox is giving creators new analytics, A/B testing and live-ops tooling designed to help them tune experiences and sustain long-term player engagement.
picks.rationale: Native A/B testing and live-ops dashboards let UGC teams tune retention with data instead of guesswork, starting on their next build.

picks.title: Roblox open-sources three of its AI safety tools through ROOST
picks.headline: Roblox open-sources three of its AI safety tools through ROOST
picks.excerpt: The platform co-founded the Robust Open Online Safety Tools Model Community with Google, OpenAI, and Discord in 2025
picks.rationale: Any studio running voice or chat can now drop battle-tested moderation models into its own stack instead of building detection from scratch.

picks.title: Free Blender add-on solves procedural spider walk cycles
picks.headline: Free Blender add-on solves procedural spider walk cycles
picks.excerpt: You move the body, and the add-on automatically figures out how the legs should step.
picks.rationale: A free rig that auto-solves multi-leg footfalls removes the worst hand-keying chore in creature animation for small teams.

picks.title: Nexxus opens an AI Labs portal with text-to-3D and text-to-game tools
picks.headline: Nexxus opens an AI Labs portal with text-to-3D and text-to-game tools
picks.excerpt: 넥써쓰가 자체 AI 프레임워크로 만든 실증 솔루션 11종을 모은 '넥써쓰 AI 랩스' 포털을 공개했다. 프롬프트로 3D 모델을 만드는 Text to 3D, 텍스트로 게임을 만드는 wasd 등 콘텐츠 제작·업무 자동화 도구가 포함됐다.
picks.rationale: Eleven working tools — prompt-to-3D models, text-to-game prototyping — are now open for devs to try rather than a roadmap slide.
